When Sirens Fall Silent - Act III: The Man | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011856

From the creators of The Town of Light and Martha Is Dead, When Sirens Fall Silent is a psychological thriller set in 1990s Italy. Players take the role of Mila, a troubled police officer investigating a high-profile series of kidnappings and murders. As the case unravels you must not only save her from herself, but from being swallowed by a vortex of violence and confusion. 

Act III: The Man is the latest chapter in a connected series of cinematic trailers. Each film reveals another fragment of Mila’s investigation, inviting viewers to piece together the mystery as it unfolds.

Coming soon to PlayStation 5.

https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019858

Sunny and Buddy are in this together.

Sunny and his fiercely loyal canine companion share an unbreakable bond as they fight side-by-side to survive the apocalypse. Together, they’ll have to make their way across the zombie-infested, sun-baked state of Arizona.

Take on hordes of zombies, play solo or team up with friends, and see how long you can survive. In multiplayer co-op, you can even play as Buddy and experience the apocalypse from a whole new perspective.

Arizona Sunshine® launches January 21, 2027 on PlayStation 5.

PRE-ORDER NOW

Pre-order Arizona Sunshine® on PlayStation 5 and get 20% off. Pre-orders on all platforms include the Desert Raiders Pack, featuring an exclusive Sunny skin and an exclusive Buddy skin. Pre-orders for the Deluxe Edition across all platforms also include 48-hour early access to the game.
